response.overview: Tobey Maguire has reportedly signed a multi-picture deal with Marvel Studios that includes production for a standalone project, Spider-Man 4  Insider circles and online scoopers (such as Daniel Richtman) have heavily speculated that Maguire is lined up to reprise his iconic web-slinger role in upcoming massive crossover events like Avengers: Doomsday and Avengers: Secret Wars  The claim that Tobey has signed a contract extension with Marvel for a standalone Spider-Man 4 UNTRUE and UNCONFIRMED!
response.title: Spider-Man 4
